component.name: ADB Scan
component.summary: Monitoring, diagnostics and tools for Android phones
Supervisión, diagnóstico y herramientas para Android

description.p: Native app (GTK 4 + libadwaita) that detects and monitors Android phones. Without turning anything on in the phone it offers a basic analysis (USB and file transfer); with USB or wireless debugging (QR code or manual pairing): live telemetry, battery, performance, apps, files, logcat, a terminal, screen mirroring with scrcpy, flashing with safeguards and a security audit without root.

Everything is processed locally, with no telemetry. It only connects to the Internet when you ask: the public IP (queried by the phone) and downloading platform-tools or scrcpy from the tools assistant. At startup it checks GitHub once for a newer version and shows a notice; nothing is downloaded until you press “Update now” (this can be turned off).
The interface is available in English and Spanish.
Overview no longer opens blank when it was the last section used.

ul.li: Root: what rooting needs to know about the phone, how to unlock each brand, and Magisk from its official site, checked before installing.
Flasher: Motorola's unlock data and unlocking with a code (Motorola, Sony).
What wakes the phone and works in the background, unrestricted battery per app, and per-app tuning (smoothness, language, game mode).
Copy contacts, calls and messages to the computer, and a checklist before selling or resetting the phone.
Usage: notifications, unlocks and apps not used in months; keyboard, night light, mobile signal, nearby Wi-Fi networks and memory per app.
Works with Android 11, Samsung and several devices connected at once.
Favorites: the star next to each section adds it to the top of the sidebar.
Any accent colour of your own, and its intensity, in Preferences.
Phone changes: apps installed, updated and uninstalled, and restarts, by day.
The open window is matched to its menu entry (desktop file).

description.p: Publishes the Windows installer, which version 1.2.0 could not build.

ul.li: Update now: ADB Scan downloads the new version, showing the percentage, checks it and installs it.
Installer for Windows, instead of the zip: Start menu, desktop shortcut and uninstalling from Settings.

description.p: Version for Windows 10 and 11, and new sections to take control of the phone without root:

ul.li: Preinstalled apps: remove and restore manufacturer and carrier apps.
Permissions: which apps can use the camera, microphone, location and other accesses, and take them away.
Storage: folders, largest files and duplicates of the phone's shared storage.
Developer tools: show touches, animation speed, resolution and density, demo mode and port forwarding.
Health report to save and share, without the serial number.
Export the installed apps and install them on another phone.
Automations that run when a phone connects.
